notes.title: FAQ: Desktop Kitten Girl
notes.notes:
[b]How to Adjust the Size of the Desktop Pet or Windows?[/b]
You can resize the desktop pet and most windows by using your mouse wheel. For specific windows, a size adjustment button is available in the lower-left corner.

[b]How to Move the Desktop Pet to Another Screen?[/b]
To drag the desktop pet across multiple monitors:
Go to Settings → System → Window Adjustment.
Customize the drag range or screen boundaries.

[b]How to Disable "Always on Top" for Windows?[/b]
By default, all windows are set to "Always on Top" upon initial launch. To disable this:
Navigate to Settings.
Uncheck the "Always on Top" option for specific windows.

[b]How to Hide the Taskbar Icon?[/b]
To hide the taskbar icon:
Go to Settings → System.
Toggle off the "Show Taskbar Icon" option.

[b]Why Does "Auto-Start on Boot" Not Work?[/b]
The auto-start feature is temporarily disabled due to unresolved technical issues. This prevents potential critical bugs. We apologize for the inconvenience and will restore it in a future update.

[b]What to Do If Save Files Are Lost/Corrupted?[/b]
If you accidentally overwrote or deleted a save file:
Open the game’s Settings and click the "Open Save Path" button.
Navigate to the Backup folder.
Select the most recently modified file, rename it to Game.KD, and overwrite the original save file.

notes.title: About the language
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, previously there was a bug in the game where the first download didn't recognize the local language correctly, we've fixed it now!

If you have played the game before, you can switch the language according to the following operation:
Use the right mouse button to click on "Pet" to open the Menu, then click on "设置", find the "语言" column and click on "简体中文" to switch the language.
